title: Onprem upgrade failures caused by tenant imagePullPolicy mismatch; automated rollforward hotfix
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Several on-prem customers reported upgrade failures during operator/Helm upgrades. Root cause analysis shows a pattern where tenant-level CRs contained imagePullPolicy: Always overrides introduced by older installer variants. The operator's post-upgrade reconcile loop treats imagePullPolicy changes from Helm hooks as a hard diff, causing repeated Helm hook execution and upgrade timeouts for tenants with restricted registry access. This ticket scopes an automated rollforward hotfix that reconciles tenant CRs and softens operator reconciliation for imagePullPolicy drift during controlled upgrades.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Install private operator using legacy installer that sets tenant.spec.runtime.imagePullPolicy=Always
2) Trigger operator upgrade via Helm 3.9 to version private-operator-2.18.1 in a tenant with private registry and limited pull permissions
3) Observe Helm pre/post hooks re-run and helm release staying in 'pending-upgrade' due to operator mutating tenant CR and Helm detecting a diff
4) Check operator logs for repeated reconcile loops and errors about image pull (ErrImagePull or ImagePullBackOff) and helm hook failures
mitigation_actions: 1) Manually patch tenant CR to set imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent for affected tenants (temporary workaround)
2) Provide customers a scripted kubectl command that updates all tenant CRs in a namespace, shipped as part of the hotfix notes
3) Escalate to support for customers with blocked upgrades and apply the scripted patch under support supervision
4) Add an emergency flag to operator (operator.env IGNORE_IMAGEPULLPOLICY_FOR_UPGRADE=true) to avoid hard-diffing imagePullPolicy during the upgrade window
proposed_fix: Introduce a two-part hotfix: (A) a safe one-off controller that scans tenant CRs and normalizes imagePullPolicy values for tenants on legacy installers; (B) operator change to treat imagePullPolicy as an upgrade-tolerant field when a controlled Helm upgrade in progress is detected.
rollout_plan: Step 1: Merge normalizer PR and cut an emergency release private-operator-2.18.1-hotfix.1
Step 2: Publish a support-runbook and one-liner kubectl patch script for customers (dry-run mode included)
Step 3: Deploy hotfix to Canary region (2 non-prod tenants) and run full upgrade scenario
Step 4: If canary passes, schedule rolling rollout to on-prem/private customers grouped by severity; for Dedicated/hosted no change
Step 5: Merge operator tolerance PR behind feature-flag and release in private-operator-2.18.2 with default feature-flag off; coordinate enabling with customer opt-in and support guidance
Step 6: Post-rollout audit: run telemetry queries to confirm upgrade success rates and zero new image pull security incidents
postmortem_followups: 1) Add a pre-upgrade validation that checks tenant CR imagePullPolicy consistency against cluster registry access and warns before upgrade
2) Update installer docs to avoid setting imagePullPolicy=Always unless explicitly requested
3) Add integration test in our CI that runs Helm upgrade on a matrix of tenant CR permutations (imagePullPolicy: Always/IfNotPresent/Never)
4) Run a sweep to find customers still using legacy installer artifacts and offer a migration window
